# Rainbow offline evidence

`card.html` is a deliberately reduced fragment of the first card captured during the
authorized 2026-09-20 diagnostic run. It preserves nesting, semantic attributes and
visible values; unrelated UI, scripts, images and tracking have been removed.

Its PLN 1551 quote is diagnostic evidence, not a production budget default. Tests
derive explicit independent scenarios by replacing a single field. No test retrieves
this source online. The raw local evidence remains in the ignored POC artifacts.

## Selected detail fixture

`detail.html` is a 5 KB reduction of the saved Gardenia detail document from the
authorized 2026-09-20 15:13 UTC investigation. It retains the actual reference-table
shape, Vue wrappers, LocalDate wrappers, selected calculator fields, active term,
connection options, meal options, room assignment/name map and flight evidence.
Unrelated page/application state, inactive date alternatives and room descriptions
were removed. References were remapped; participant birth dates were replaced
consistently with synthetic adult dates. No tracking/session identifiers are included.
Opaque offer keys are public source identity evidence, not authentication credentials.

The fixture preserves the selected HB choice's distinct opaque key and the inactive
WAW/AI choices. Their raw surcharges are not independently verified alternative prices.
The fixture does not establish mandatory cost completeness or current availability.

Tests read this checked-in fixture only, then construct explicit contradictory cases
with an independent test encoder. Malformed reference graphs are independently authored.
A fully reindexed table and a synthetic different product/date/room/price scenario
check that the parser does not depend on original positions or Gardenia constants.
The raw ignored HTML is not required to run tests.
